name: Arcturus Defense Solutions MAR-8X 'Longbow Mk.II'
description:
The MAR-8X is the next evolution of Arcturus' magnetic accelerator rifle platform, upgrading the original Longbow with a dual-stage electromagnetic acceleration system that launches 4mm tungsten penetrators at hypersonic velocity. The projectiles carry no propellant — kinetic energy alone provides devastating terminal effects, punching through Level IV armor at 400 meters and maintaining lethal velocity beyond 800.

Power consumption remains the platform's primary constraint. The MAR-8X draws from a belt-mounted capacitor pack that provides 60 shots before requiring a 90-second field recharge from any standard power source. The weapon is silent save for the supersonic crack of the projectile and a faint electromagnetic hum during the capacitor charge cycle. BCI integration is mandatory — the fire-control system requires neural input to manage the acceleration timing.

Arcturus restricts MAR-8X sales to Tier 4+ military contracts, but the original Longbow's proliferation means experienced technicians can sometimes upgrade older units to near-8X specifications. These bootleg conversions are dangerous — an improperly calibrated acceleration coil can detonate the capacitor pack.
specifications: caliber: 4mm tungsten penetrator effective_range: 800m rate_of_fire: 120 rpm (semi-auto, capacitor-limited) magazine_capacity: 60 penetrators per capacitor charge weight: 5.2 kg (rifle) + 1.8 kg (capacitor pack)
tactical_use: The MAR-8X fills the role of a squad-level anti-armor rifle. Its tungsten penetrators defeat personal armor, light vehicle plating, and hardened cover that would stop conventional rounds. The near-silent firing signature makes it devastating in ambush scenarios. The mandatory BCI link means only neurally-augmented operators can field the weapon, creating a natural restriction on unauthorized use.
cultural_context: The Longbow platform represents the cutting edge of personal electromagnetic weapons. Possessing an 8X variant signals either deep corporate connections or extremely dangerous black-market contacts. Bootleg Longbow conversions are a thriving underground industry — and a regular source of casualties when capacitor packs detonate during firing.
story_hooks: A bootleg MAR-8X conversion detonated during a freelance operation, killing the operator. The capacitor pack was deliberately sabotaged — someone is assassinating people through their weapons.
Arcturus is field-testing a MAR-8X variant that uses the operator's BCI to calculate ricochets off hard surfaces — corner-shooting with tungsten penetrators.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, angular assault rifle with a pronounced top-mounted rail and dual electromagnetic coil housings running the length of the barrel assembly. The profile suggests advanced technology — no traditional gas tube, instead featuring visible capacitor integration points and a distinctive muzzle that widens slightly at the aperture. The design reads as purpose-built military hardware: aggressive, modular, and distinctly non-conventional.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length 94 cm, barrel length 52 cm, width across coil housing 8.5 cm at widest point
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly balanced despite the 5.2 kg rifle mass — the dual-stage coil system distributes weight evenly along the receiver. When paired with the belt-mounted capacitor pack (1.8 kg), the total system feels heavy but manageable for a neural-augmented operator. The rifle alone sits comfortably in the weapon-ready position.
physical_description.primary_material: Titanium-carbon composite receiver with reinforced steel electromagnetic coil housings. The barrel assembly integrates tungsten-lined acceleration chambers.
physical_description.finish: Matte gun-metal gray primary finish with brushed steel accents on the coil housings. Thermal management vents on the receiver show slight oxidation from capacitor discharge heat. Areas around the BCI neural interface port display subtle iridescent discoloration from electromagnetic field stress.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary body with silver-brushed steel coil housings. BCI neural-link port features minimal cyan indicator trim. Capacitor pack connector glows faint amber during charge cycles.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer grip with subtle ridging for augmented fingers. The selector lever and charging handle feature thin knurled steel bands for tactile feedback even through heavy gloves or synthetic skin.
distinctive_features: Dual electromagnetic coil housings visible along barrel — stacked configuration suggests staged acceleration
Top-mounted BCI neural-interface node with recessed connector port — glossy black ceramic housing
Muzzle aperture widens into a faint magnetic field shaper at the exit — no traditional flash hider
Capacitor pack connector jack on the receiver rear — heavy-gauge contacts with amber indicator LED
Thermal management vents along receiver sides — fine slotted design with burn marks from repeated discharge cycles
Serial number and Arcturus Defense Solutions marking on the left receiver plate in white stencil
Sight rail shows Picatinny standard but includes additional electromagnetic field hardening plating
Magazine well replaced by penetrator feed system — sealed housing suggests advanced ammunition handling
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Arcturus Defense Solutions logo — stylized compass point — stamped in white on left receiver. Serial number in contrasting white stencil below. 'MAR-8X LONGBOW MK.II' designation engraved on the dust cover. Blackwood Commercial Group subcontractor mark appears as a small brass plate on the capacitor pack connector.
physical_description.condition_typical: Military-grade condition — well-maintained but showing evidence of field use. Slight wear on the grip from gloved handling, minor scorching around thermal vents from regular capacitor discharge, imperceptible micro-scratches on the coil housings from equipment contact. No corrosion — the weapon is clearly kept clean despite operational intensity.
